name: savvy-progress
description: Progress bar above the prompt for /savvy-flow, plus an agents panel (/agents-info): running, finished and planned subagents with model, task progress, context, cost and time.

language.title: Panel language
language.description: auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale; en, ru or he (Hebrew, drawn right to left)

autoOpen.title: Open the agents panel
autoOpen.description: savvy: when a savvy-flow worker starts or a plan is reported; any: also when any other subagent starts

cost.title: Estimated cost
cost.description: show: draw the estimated dollar cost in the agents panel; hide: leave it out (tokens, context and time stay)

band.title: Band above the prompt
band.description: flow: only while a savvy-flow plan is reported or a savvy-* worker runs; agents: also a compact band as soon as any subagent has run
